title: Choir layer (overlap)
description: Layers several AI voices that sing the linked lyrics together, slightly spread apart in time. It needs lyrics as input, the ACE-Step plugin, and gives audio.

parameters.name: spread
parameters.doc: Amount of timing spread between the voice layers.

parameters.name: channels
parameters.doc: auto: stereo when an input or the source is stereo, otherwise mono; mono: sum to mono; stereo: always two channels (a mono sound is copied to both).

needs: Timed lyrics linked to the lyrics input.
